narrative.overview: Old leather, wood, aged gold and emerald fittings make the browser feel part of Kyrandia. Generated illustrations carry material detail; readable controls and generous game framing carry the interface. The original 320 × 200 game remains the focal point once the book opens.
keyCharacteristics: Pixel illustrations and original game sprites, with a physical 3D book as the entrance.
Warm shadows, parchment lettering and deep green controls.
Motion for opening the story and acknowledging input, not perpetual decoration.
dos: Do keep the game view unobscured and the next action visible.
Do preserve the original cursor, pixel density and scene framing.
Do check the book, menu, help and settings at desktop and narrow mobile sizes.
Do retain reduced-motion and WebGL-fallback paths.
donts: Don't replace generated material art with generic gradients or decorative cards.
Don't add continuous book rendering, oversized downloads or ornamental controls without a functional reason.
